title: Item Limit for Optional Coverage Add-Ons Work by Homeowner Tier
content:
The authorized item limit for repair or replacement work under an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider follows the tier of the base Homeowner Service Contracts contract the rider is attached to:

| Base contract tier | Authorized item limit |
|---|---|
| Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum | USD 3500.00 |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Gold | USD 3000.00 |
| Any other homeowner tier | The rider's own per-request cap |
| A rental property or real estate base | The rider's own per-request cap |

The tier read is the one recorded on the base homeowner contract.

**Hypothetical cases.**

- A Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider on a Bridgewell HomeCare Gold contract: the item limit is USD 3000.00.
- A Bridgewell Well Pump Rider on a Bridgewell HomeCare Silver contract: the item limit is the Well Pump Rider's own per-request cap.
- A Bridgewell Septic System Rider on a Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum contract: the item limit is USD 3500.00.
